user.title: Firecrawl Web Search
user.description: Configure the Firecrawl endpoint and defaults. The URL is test-searched before saving.

data_description.url: Base URL or full search URL.
data_description.api_key: Optional. Required for the hosted Firecrawl API.

data_description.results: 1-10. Used when the model does not request a specific count.
data_description.default_lang: Two-letter language code used when the model does not provide one.

data_description.enable_read_page: Adds a tool that fetches the full markdown of a result URL.
data_description.cache_max_age_hours: 0-168 hours. 0 always fetches a fresh page.
data_description.wait_for: 0-60 seconds. Extra wait before extracting the page.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect: check the host/port and that the Firecrawl stack is running.
error.bad_search_path: The server answered, but the search endpoint ("/v2/search") was not found.
error.invalid_auth: The Firecrawl API key was rejected.
error.invalid_response: The server answered, but not with Firecrawl search JSON.

abort.already_configured: Firecrawl Web Search is already configured. Use its options to change the settings.
